earnings.title: Fellow Shareholders, November 2, 2026
highlights: In Q3, Platform revenue grew 23% year over year (YoY) to $1.3 billion, with both Advertising and Subscriptions growing 23%.
Total gross profit was $649 million, up 24% YoY, and we generated net income of $183 million, Adjusted EBITDA of $249 million, and Free Cash Flow (TTM) of $796 million.
Total net revenue was $1.5 billion, up 24% YoY
Platform revenue was $1.3 billion, up 23% YoY

items.heading: If we fail to differentiate our streaming platform and compete successfully with our competitors, it will be difficult for us to attract and retain users and our business will be adversely impacted.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: Our competitors offer content and other advertising mediums that may be more attractive to advertisers than our streaming platform.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: If advertisers continue to devote a substantial portion of their advertising budgets to advertising in traditional media or on other digital platforms rather than on advertising on our streaming platform, the future growth of our business may be negatively impacted.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: If we are unable to maintain an appropriate supply of quality video advertising inventory on our streaming platform or generate sufficient demand to effectively sell our available video advertising inventory, our business may be harmed.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: If the advertising campaigns that run on our streaming platform decrease or are not relevant or not engaging to our users, our business may be harmed.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

items.heading: We are subject to various risks in connection with programmatic advertising.
